svg.title: Four compound and disease connections, two noticed and two searched for
svg.desc: Four dated rows for sildenafil, thalidomide, fish oil and baricitinib on one shared time axis, each showing when the connection was on record and what test or approval followed; sildenafil and baricitinib carry enlarged panels.
svg.text: Four compound and disease connections: two noticed, two searched for
Each relationship sat in existing records before anyone tested it. The route by which it was found, at the bedside or by search, does
not change the test it has to pass.
What the record held, and when

Noticed: volunteers in a dosing study
reported an effect nobody was looking for.
A trial program and an approval. The
volunteers’ reports are why the trials ran,
not evidence that the drug works.
Noticed: clinicians reported a response in a
disease far from the drug’s first use.
